limits: The reviewer ran portable CPU proc/file/query fixtures on Darwin and independent temporary filesystem race probes only; no local live Linux capture, SSH, nvidia-smi, GPU allocation or queue action was performed.

The root-produced remote raw observations reached five nodes:40H100, all compute occupied in each sample. N4-1 transport failed; its card state is unknown. This evidence supplies no exclusive lease or current allocation right.

Raw recon proc fields were read once after both GPU queries, without the production process_fact identity sandwich or pidfds. They are observational facts, not original-queue ownership/ancestry/control proof.

Raw recon did not run the new capture module or hash current source/runtime/data/weights, import Torch, establish optimizer semantics or pause/restore a queue. Native source closure and real model stage remain pending.

The capture accepts only allowed alias labels; caller transport/source declaration must bind the actual hostname/address. The supplied recon transport destinations were independently checked against exactly six allowed addresses.

Per-file hashing and directory identity checks prove scoped read-time stability; they are not a global filesystem transaction or a lock excluding nonparticipating writers. Immutable files must be freshly rechecked under a valid future stage.

Borrowed_same_process capture is a read-only supplied identity inventory, not the missing xiaofan queue adapter or a validated recoverable optimizer boundary. HTTP availability does not prove PID socket ownership.
